opcodeExplanations.LOAD_IMM: Put a small immediate number into a register.
opcodeExplanations.LOAD_CONST: Put a constant value such as nil, string, or boolean into a register.
opcodeExplanations.MOV: Copy a value from one register to another.
opcodeExplanations.ADD: Add two values and store the result.
opcodeExplanations.SUB: Subtract the right value from the left value.
opcodeExplanations.GT: Check whether the left value is greater than the right value.
opcodeExplanations.LT: Check whether the left value is less than the right value.
opcodeExplanations.LEN: Compute Lua length, often used for table length.
opcodeExplanations.JZ: Jump when the condition is Lua-false, meaning nil or false.
opcodeExplanations.JNZ: Jump when the condition is Lua-truthy.
opcodeExplanations.LABEL: A named point in the bytecode; execution falls through it.
opcodeExplanations.CLOSURE: Create a function closure and capture any upvalue cells.
opcodeExplanations.MAKE_CELL: Wrap a local value in a mutable cell so closures can share it.
opcodeExplanations.CELL_GET: Read the current value from an upvalue cell.
opcodeExplanations.CELL_SET: Write a new value into an upvalue cell.
opcodeExplanations.BIND_UPVALUE: Bind this function's local cell register to a captured upvalue.
opcodeExplanations.PARAM: Push one argument into the pending argument list.
opcodeExplanations.PARAM_EXPAND: Push multiple values from a list-like result into arguments.
opcodeExplanations.CALL_VALUE: Call a function value or builtin using the pending arguments.
opcodeExplanations.TAIL_CALL_VALUE: Call in tail position, replacing the current frame when possible.
opcodeExplanations.ARG: Move one incoming function argument into a local register.
opcodeExplanations.RESULT: Read the first value returned by the previous call.
opcodeExplanations.RESULT_LIST: Read all values returned by the previous call as a list.
opcodeExplanations.RETURN: Return one value from the current function.
opcodeExplanations.RETURN_MULTI: Return multiple values from the current function.
opcodeExplanations.TABLE_SET: Write a key/value pair into a table.
opcodeExplanations.TABLE_GET: Read a value from a table by key.
opcodeExplanations.TABLE_APPEND: Append an array-style value to a table.

demos.title: Table Loop
demos.summary: A table constructor plus numeric for loop reads values and accumulates a sum.
demos.source:
local values = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
local sum = 0

for i = 1, #values do
  sum = sum + values[i]
end

return sum
